currentRepair.typeSpec: Separate upstream React-element typing/composition obligations below remain independently classified; runtime completion does not qualify them.

review: All 14 upstream runtime bodies manually compared against the full existing internal renderer suite. No existing tests exist under packages/solid/src/use-render. User ownership permits editing existing family tests only; neither creating a new family test nor editing the internal suite was authorized. This ledger completes the audit but does not claim complete TEST parity.
lane: jsdom; source has no environment predicates
adaptation: createRender/useRender aliases createRenderElement with params.defaultTagName or div; React render elements require native render callbacks, className becomes class, React object refs become native callback refs. Reading the wrapper implementation alone is not runtime coverage of its public behavior.

cases.title: render props does not overwrite className in a render function when unspecified
assertions: class attribute exactly 'my-span ' including trailing space
cases.evidence: Internal callback tests do not assert unspecified-class fallback or the exact class attribute including trailing space. Conformance callback-class tests exercise supplied classes, a different condition.

cases.title: refs are handled as expected
actions: mount public useRender with two parameter refs
assertions: both refs current exactly first element
targetTitles: reads ref getters only for their own inputs while attributes and measured styles stay live
cases.evidence: Related internal test composes one parameter ref and a prop ref, asserts prop ref host and later parameter-ref host. It does not test two simultaneous parameter refs through the public wrapper or the source two-ref collection. Shared conformance tests check component/render-host refs, not this public parameter array.
